paragraphs.text: Tyarel was a village in Eastern Kjeldor , on the continent of Terisiare at the time of the Dominarian Ice Age .

Tyarel was located eighty miles outside Jornstad. Although it was small, it was located next to a major trade route. It was constantly busy, with caravans and travelers arriving at all hours of the day, soldiers and diplomats faithfully executing the orders of the king, and merchants offering their wares to those who passed through. Tyarel was the village where Finroy grew up.
